body:
View changelog on https://syncmyl2p.de/

macOS version is still missing as I have currently problems with the virtual machine.

Please note:
This is the last version that will be published by me. In the future the RWTH will maintain and further develop the tool.

name: Fix moodle bugs
body:
* Fix encoding issues
* Remove special characters from directory and file names
* Check if moodle permissions are given
* Catch too long filepaths

name: A lot of fixes and minor improvements
body:
Some changes:
- Added tutor documents
- Saving program state is fixed and should be more robust now
- Changed Icons
- Changed all links to new website
- Fixed Reachability check
- Improved error handling

name: Fixing small bugs
body: Check for updates is disableable and resizing the window on osx works again.

name: New version, new features!
body:
New features include a widget for announcements and emails but also an update notification on startup, if there is a new version available.

Choose the according file for your operating system.

name: Final Release for new L2P
body:
Final working release which is compatible with the new version of the l2p.
There is a version for each operating system.
